name: call_mcp_tool_async
description: Call an MCP server tool asynchronously (fire-and-forget). Returns immediately with a call_id; use check_mcp_call_status to poll or wait_for_mcp_call to block. Prefer this over use_mcp_tool / mcp--<server>--<tool> for long-running calls or when fanning out multiple independent MCP calls in parallel.

arguments.description: A JSON object containing the tool's input parameters, following the tool's input schema. Pass null if the tool takes no arguments.

server_name.description: The name of the MCP server providing the tool.

source.description: Optional disambiguator when multiple MCP servers share the same name. "global" selects the user-level server, "project" the workspace-level one. Omit or pass null to use the default resolution.

tool_name.description: The name of the tool to execute on the MCP server.
